verification: Parent-verified public documentation, public CLI 13.6.1 help, and exact published API references. This worktree downloaded only official screenshot assets; no dashboard startup, integration install, native run/build, publish, deploy or cloud provisioning was performed.
examples: Documented reference syntax/patterns, not additional recorded CLI runs or fictional generated output. Docker Compose is an illustrative supported target, not a target selected by the user or configured in the weather demo.

dashboard.integrated: Starting C#/TypeScript AppHosts launches the dashboard connected to the resource service. State, health, console, configuration and lifecycle are separate from instrumented OTLP logs/traces/metrics.
dashboard.standalone: Any instrumented OTLP emitter; no AppHost required. No automatic process orchestration/health/console/lifecycle without a connected resource service. Designed for development and short-term diagnostics, not unlimited production monitoring.
dashboard.imageTag: Documented mutable public tag, not a pinned release claim.
dashboard.auth: Default browser authentication retained. Loopback bindings are an explicitly labeled safety adaptation; no public anonymous access or login tokens are shown.

deployment.dashboard: WithDashboard(bool enabled = true) is an explicit Compose-environment opt-in, not an automatic all-target claim.
deployment.publish: Generates target artifacts from the configured AppHost. Compose artifact shapes are docker-compose.yaml/.env. Does not build images or apply deployment.
deployment.deploy: Applies the configured target pipeline from the AppHost model, not an old publish folder; deploys declared resources, not the AppHost process. Compose resolves parameters, builds images and runs Compose up.
deployment.scope: Reference commands use explicit placeholder paths/environment. Weather AddExecutable/Vite development graph is unchanged and has not been deployed. Cloud targets require appropriate integrations, provider setup/authentication and parameters.

versionedContext.api: Package.{version}.json is generated from exact assembly assets using catalog-pinned versions/release feeds.
versionedContext.narrative: Reviewed release publication supplies the current llms-full.txt narrative corpus. Astro explicitly excludes reference/api/**.
versionedContext.cliBoundary: The existing public 13.6.1 captures retrieve current published corpus/API references; they do not prove automatic matching-semver selection.
